dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>That voice... I believe it was coming from the sea!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Aquela voz... acredito que vinha do mar!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>That was LOUD. So much for my nap...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>Isso foi muito alto para a minha sesta...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Who could have a cry like that? I’m kinda scared...
But...let’s go check it out!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Quem poderia ter um choro assim? Eu estou meio assustado...
Mas... vamos dar uma olhada!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(3,29)><$voicel(3,7)>That was a Pokémon’s voice just now, wasn’t it? Who could
it be? This is so EXCITING!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(3,29)><$voicel(3,7)>Essa foi a voz de um Pokémon, não foi?
Isto é tão emocionante!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>What the heck was that loud cry? We gotta go find out!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Hurry and rescue <$cdef(27)>Onix from the cave before this rain
lets up!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Rápido e salva-te. <$cdef(27)>Onix Da caverna antes desta chuva
Levanta-te!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Yayyy! Rain! D’you think <$cdef(27)>Onix</color> can get out now?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Yayyy! Chuva! Você acha <$cdef(27)>Onix</color> Já pode sair?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>I bet you could just SMASH through those walls and get
<$cdef(27)>Onix out now!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Aposto que pode atravessar aquelas paredes e ir
<$cdef(27)>Onix Saiam já!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(3,14)><$voicel(3,7)>Go help <$cdef(27)>Onix</color>! They’re stuck in a cave, right?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(3,14)><$voicel(3,7)>Vai ajudar. <$cdef(27)>Onix</color>Eles estão presos em uma caverna, certo?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>Onix needs help, right? You should go see
’em, <$cdef(27)>!

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I’m so glad <$cdef(27)>Onix got out safely! Maybe you should, like,
let the <$cdef(27)>professor know too?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Estou tão feliz <$cdef(27)>Onix Talvez devesses, tipo,
deixar o <$cdef(27)>professor sabe também?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>We did it! <$cdef(27)>Onix</color> is saved! The <$cdef(27)>professor</color> was so worried!

<$emotion(3,38)><$voicel(3,9)>I KNEW you could rescue <$cdef(27)>Onix! Yippee! You should go tell
the <$cdef(27)>professor!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(3,38)><$voicel(3,9)>Eu sabia que podias salvar-me. <$cdef(27)>OnixDevias ir dizer-lhe que o teu pai é um idiota.
a <$cdef(27)>professor!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I’m glad <$cdef(27)>Onix</color> is OK! You should tell the <$cdef(27)>professor</color>, too!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Fico contente <$cdef(27)>Onix</color> Está bem! Você deve dizer ao <$cdef(27)>professor</color>Também!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,8)><$cdef(27)>! Hey, bud! Got a sec? There’s
somethin’
I
wanna
talk
to
you about...

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,9)>Making it rain to help me break outta that cave was pretty
wild! <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>I can’t thank ya enough for the help!
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,4)>But, uh... To tell you the truth, I don’t do so great in real
damp environments...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,9)>Fazer chover para me ajudar a sair daquela caverna era bonito.
Selvagem! <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Não posso agradecer o suficiente pela ajuda!
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,4)>Mas, uh... Para dizer a verdade, eu não faço tão grande em real
Ambientes húmidos...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>If you’re still in a helpin’-Pokémon mood, it’d be real
awesome if you could make me a home that stays nice
’n’ dry even in the rain. <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)>That somethin’ you can do?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Se você ainda estiver de bom humor, será real
incrível se você poderia me fazer um lar que permanece agradável
‘n’ seca até mesmo na chuva. <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)>Isso é algo que você pode fazer?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)>You wouldn’t happen to know how to make a home that
stays nice ’n’ dry even in the rain, would ya?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)>Você não saberia como fazer um lar que
fica bom 'n' seco mesmo na chuva, você faria?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,7)>Hey, heyyy! You made me a home that’ll stay nice ’n’ dry—
just the way I like it! <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Thanks a ton, bud! You’re the best!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,7)>Hey, heyyy! Você me fez uma casa que vai ficar bom 'n' seco-
Tal como eu gosto! <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Obrigado uma tonelada, amigo! Você é o melhor!
